description: The ML Telecom Architect is responsible for designing and deploying machine learning models tailored to telecom use cases. The role focuses on developing intelligent systems for detecting fraudulent calls, analyzing suspicious links, and enhancing network security through predictive analytics. A solid understanding of telecom protocols and data flows is essential to identify anomalies and improve system reliability. In addition to fraud detection, the architect will collaborate with network and data science teams to integrate ML solutions into telecom platforms, optimizing real-time decision-making. The candidate should be proficient in supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, with experience in handling large-scale telecom datasets to extract actionable insights.
